cards.label: Agüero scores dramatic title-winning goal

tooltip.description: Sergio Agüero scores in the 94th minute against QPR to secure Manchester City's first league title since 1968 in one of the most dramatic moments in Premier League history.
tooltip.quote: "AGÜEROOOOO!!! I swear you'll never see anything like this ever again!" – Martin Tyler

cards.label: Pirlo bends in beauty from long range

tooltip.description: Andrea Pirlo unleashes a trademark long-range strike for AC Milan against Parma, sending it soaring into the top corner.
tooltip.quote: "Pirlo doesn’t score often—but when he does, it’s a work of art."

cards.label: Balotelli stuns Germany at Euro

tooltip.description: Mario Balotelli smashes in a screamer and unleashes one of football’s most iconic celebrations in the Euro 2012 semifinal.
tooltip.quote: "Why always me?" – Balotelli

cards.label: Van Persie launches the flying header

tooltip.description: Robin van Persie scores one of the most acrobatic goals in World Cup history with a soaring diving header over Iker Casillas.
tooltip.quote: "He flew, he absolutely flew!"

cards.label: Ronaldo unleashes a 40-yard rocket

tooltip.description: Cristiano Ronaldo shocks Porto with a goal from near midfield, earning the first-ever FIFA Puskás Award.
tooltip.quote: "That is a goal of a lifetime!"

cards.label: Messi weaves through Real Madrid

tooltip.description: Messi slices through the heart of Real Madrid’s defense to score a breathtaking solo goal in the Champions League semifinal.
tooltip.quote: "Once again, the little man who makes the big difference!"

cards.label: Roberto Carlos bends physics

tooltip.description: Roberto Carlos scores an impossible free kick from 35 meters, curving the ball around the wall in a way that left even scientists puzzled.
tooltip.quote: "It was not a goal. It was a miracle." – Arsène Wenger

cards.label: Manolas completes Roma’s miracle

tooltip.description: Kostas Manolas scores a dramatic header to eliminate Barcelona and complete Roma’s stunning comeback in the Champions League.
tooltip.quote: "Roma have risen from their ruins!" – Peter Drury

cards.label: James scores the volley of the tournament

tooltip.description: James Rodríguez controls the ball on his chest and fires a sublime volley into the net, stunning Uruguay in the World Cup knockout round.
tooltip.quote: "That is why you play the game... to witness moments like this."

cards.label: Bergkamp bends space and time

tooltip.description: Dennis Bergkamp stuns Newcastle with a physics-defying touch, flicking the ball around the defender before calmly finishing.
tooltip.quote: "That’s not just skill — that’s sorcery."

cards.label: Messi breaks ankles, then Bayern

tooltip.description: Lionel Messi twists Jérôme Boateng into the turf before dinking the ball over Manuel Neuer in a moment of pure football poetry.
tooltip.quote: "Here he is again. That’s astonishing. It’s absolutely world class."

cards.label: Beckham bends England into the World Cup

tooltip.description: In the 93rd minute, David Beckham scores a stunning free kick to send England to the 2002 World Cup, erupting Wembley into chaos.
tooltip.quote: "Give him a cape and a mask — Beckham is a superhero!"

cards.label: Essien launches a left-foot rocket

tooltip.description: Michael Essien unleashes a blistering volley off the underside of the crossbar against Barcelona in a Champions League classic.
tooltip.quote: "What a hit! An absolute missile from Essien!"

cards.label: Ronaldinho toe-pokes through time and space

tooltip.description: With defenders swarming and barely any backlift, Ronaldinho stuns Chelsea with a delicate toe-poke from distance into the bottom corner.
tooltip.quote: "He made time stand still. That’s genius."

cards.label: Götze wins the World Cup in extra time

tooltip.description: Mario Götze controls the ball with his chest and buries a volley past Argentina to secure Germany’s fourth World Cup title.
tooltip.quote: "Show the world you're better than Messi tonight." – Joachim Löw

cards.label: Rooney stuns City with bicycle brilliance

tooltip.description: Wayne Rooney leaps into the air and delivers a thunderous overhead kick against rivals Manchester City — a goal for the ages.
tooltip.quote: "You’ll never see a better goal in your life. Ever." – Martin Tyler

cards.label: Zlatan scores the impossible overhead

tooltip.description: Ibrahimović shocks England with a gravity-defying 40-yard bicycle kick, scoring one of the most unbelievable goals in football history.
tooltip.quote: "You don’t explain Zlatan. Zlatan explains you."

cards.label: Van Bronckhorst fires a rocket into history

tooltip.description: In his final international tournament, van Bronckhorst unleashes a 40-yard screamer in the World Cup semifinal that stuns Uruguay and inspires a nation.
tooltip.quote: "He won't score a better goal — because nobody will."

cards.label: Ronaldo earns a standing ovation in Turin

tooltip.description: Cristiano Ronaldo stuns Juventus with a perfect bicycle kick that even their own fans applauded. A goal of the decade contender.
tooltip.quote: "You can’t do that. You just can’t do that!"

cards.label: Zidane volleys a Champions League masterpiece

tooltip.description: Zidane times it to perfection, meeting a looping cross with a left-footed volley from the edge of the box to win the Champions League in style.
tooltip.quote: "A goal of beauty, a goal of greatness, a goal for eternity."

cards.label: Éder silences France in extra time

tooltip.description: Éder drives forward in the 109th minute and lashes in a stunning low strike from distance to win the Euro 2016 Final for Portugal.
tooltip.quote: "The unlikeliest of heroes writes Portugal’s name into history."

cards.label: Zlatan unleashes a missile on Anderlecht

tooltip.description: Ibrahimović smashes a devastating volley from long range, completing his hat-trick with a goal so powerful it echoed through Europe.
tooltip.quote: "The net is still shaking."
